The '''Alderaanian tourist board''' was an organization based on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the task of which was to attract tourists to that [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. At some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the tourist board produced a [[Alderaanian tourist board Holoplay 2735|holographic advertisement]] that highlighted Alderaanian locations including the [[Lakes Region]] and the [[Cobaltia Sea/Legends|Cobaltia Sea]].
